hypothesis: Persistent closes near the same side of completed 8-hour ranges reveal directional auction pressure that forecasts returns after controlling for formation-period close-to-close return.
falsifier: Reject the mechanism if the baseline lacks stable positive net edge across development folds and cost stresses, or if exact sign inversion performs comparably or better.
formation_horizon: 126 completed 8-hour bars (42 days), with 42-bar exponential half-life and at least 100 valid nonzero-range bars.
rebalance_horizon: Weekly at Monday 00:00 UTC; all other decision boundaries preserve current quantities.
control_profile: Cross-sectionally residualize persistence pressure against average-ranked same-horizon close return, then form a rank-weighted dollar-neutral 1.0 gross book.
